title: New parapsychology degree program at the California Institute for Human Science

tellings.quote: I just helped to create a doctoral and a master's degree program that includes a specialization in parasychology at the California Institute for Human Science

plain: A researcher with a doctorate, Jeffrey Mishlove, says he has just helped create a doctoral and a master's degree programme at the California Institute for Human Science that includes a specialization in parapsychology, the study of claimed psychic abilities. He presents it as a sign that the subject is getting a formal place in higher education.
